topic: Data filtering requirements for Japanese data
summary_markdown: The conversation covered two unrelated topics. First, [p1] requested assistance running the `stage_to_prod` script due to a system reinstallation (Ubuntu 24.04). Later, [me] asked for clarification on the required data scope for Japanese records. [p1] confirmed that the data needs to be filtered for one month of savings, specifically November 2024 (files in folders starting with `202411`). It was noted that some resulting data might contain information from October 2024, which is acceptable.
decisions: Japanese data must be filtered to cover one month of savings: November 2024.
